rivalries.methodology: All league-wide rivalry superlatives except most-played require at least five meetings. Nemesis and favorite opponent use lowest/highest row-manager win percentage with the same five-meeting minimum, breaking ties by meetings. Closest rivalry minimizes distance from .500; one-sided rivalry maximizes it; highest-scoring uses average combined score.
